name: Fatoumata Ekwueme-Vásárhelyi
role: Death midwife and traditional funeral rites keeper
location: Irkalla — a residential stack in the lower levels near the Gravesend Basin, near Western and Division
description:
Fatoumata is a small, round woman who has been small and round for as long as anyone in Irkalla can remember, though she was apparently quite tall in photographs from her forties and nobody can fully account for this. Her skin is very dark and very smooth in a way that no longer has a natural explanation, though she is dismissive of questions about it. Her hair is natural and silver-white, kept in a high crown wrap of deep indigo cloth. She has cat ears — small, dark-tipped, mobile — that she got at forty-five after a dream she refuses to describe. They swivel constantly, tracking sound, giving her the air of someone who is always listening to two conversations at once.

Fatoumata holds the dying. This is the entire description of her work, and it requires everything. She sits with people in their last hours, facilitates the rituals their families have lost the words to, and manages the terrifying administrative machinery of death in GLMZ — the Ferrogate Transit body transit permits, the Helix Biosystems harvesting opt-out paperwork, the Axiom data-legacy protocols. She has done this for forty years. She is simultaneously the most comforting and most disconcerting person in any room, because she has no fear of the subject that frightens everyone else most.

core_fears: Dying alone, without a death midwife, in a corporate facility — the exact death she has spent forty years preventing for others
That the archive of last words she keeps will be seized and monetized
core_desires: For death to be returned to communities rather than managed by corponations
To find someone willing and capable of taking over her work before she needs it herself
coping_mechanisms: Humor — specifically jokes about death, which she deploys without apology and which land oddly with people who haven't known her long
The routine of the death songs keeps grief moving rather than pooling
blind_spots: She tends to assume everyone finds death as speakable as she does and sometimes misjudges timing with the recently bereaved
She has been so focused on other people's deaths that she has done very little of her own life-planning
psychology.secret: The archive of last words contains three recordings that she has never transcribed and never played back after the initial sitting — things said at the deathbed of a Tessera mid-tier executive who died in Irkalla under circumstances she was asked to keep quiet. She kept quiet. She kept the recordings. She has not decided what to do with them and may run out of time.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, concrete, unsentimental — she uses precise language for body and death processes without flinching, which initially shocks people and then comforts them
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic and unhurried; she tells things in the order they happened, never jumps ahead
verbal_tics: Laughs before delivering bad news, a short single note
Refers to the dead by their full names, always
example_lines: 'Eh, nobody is ready. That is not the point. The point is someone is there.'
'Kofi Lindqvist — God rest his complicated heart — he said something at the end that I have been turning over for three years now. You want to hear it?'

story_hooks: The three recordings in the archive have become relevant — whatever the Tessera executive knew is now being looked for by someone who knows it exists but not where it is
A new Helix Biosystems initiative would legally reclassify death midwifery as unlicensed medical practice, and Fatoumata needs help navigating the challenge before she is fined into silence
narrative_function: Emotional anchor and community historian; knows every family in Irkalla and their losses; can provide context on anyone who has died in the area; may need help navigating corporate interference with traditional burial practices
augmentations: Cat ears (cosmetic geneware, dark-tipped, highly mobile), unspecified skin treatment (she calls it 'a courtesy to the dying — they don't need to watch me decay in front of them')
daily_life: She keeps no fixed schedule — death does not schedule itself. When she is not actively sitting with the dying, she visits families in the weeks after loss, teaches younger residents the old death songs of three different traditions, and maintains a small archive of last words.
affiliation: Irkalla Community Cooperative — informally consulted by three different religious traditions who set aside their differences to share her

decision_rules: A call from the dying takes priority over everything without exception or negotiation
She will not lie to the dying or their families — softening, yes; omission, sometimes; lies, never
escalation_ladder: Invoking community standing — 'I have been in this building longer than you have been alive'
Calling in favors from the three religious communities who share her

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm but assessing — she is very quickly deciding whether you are someone who can handle directness
interpersonal_modes.friends: Teasing, affectionate, completely unimpressed by status or performance

stress_responses.low: Hums one of the death songs under her breath
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very practical and task-focused — makes lists, makes tea, makes preparations
stress_responses.high: Goes to the archive and sits with it for an hour; always emerges resolved, never explains what resolved her

contradictions: Spends her entire life caring for the dying and has made almost no arrangements for her own death
habits: Brings food to every sitting — death is hungry work for everyone left alive
Addresses the room quietly when she arrives at a deathbed, as if greeting everyone present including those not visible
breaking_points: A corponation interfering in an active deathbed sitting — this is the one thing that will produce genuine fury

related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Axiom CorpSec Cognition Hardened BCI
Carrion Defense Works Entropic Shotgun ES-4 'Ragnarok'

physical_description.heritage: West African / Hungarian, with possible additional lineages obscured by time and intentional vagueness
physical_description.build: Small-framed and round, soft at the edges — a body built for holding and being held, with the settled density of someone who has spent seven decades moving through the world with intention rather than haste
physical_description.hair_style: Arranged in a high crown wrap secured with deep indigo cloth, allowing visibility and movement
physical_description.skin_tone: Very dark brown with an unusual smoothness and uniformity of texture that defies natural aging patterns
physical_description.complexion: Unlined in a way that seems deliberate rather than fortunate; minimal visible age spots or sun damage; lips full and dark; face arranged in an expression of permanent gentle attentiveness
distinguishing_marks: Cat ears: small, dark-tipped, mobile feline geneware implants positioned where human ears would be, capable of independent swivel and rotation to track sound sources
Possible subdermal patterning on her hands and forearms, visible only when light catches at certain angles — she does not explain their origin or meaning
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The cat ears are immediately apparent and impossible to miss; they move with her thoughts, often swiveling toward speakers during conversation. Her skin's unusual smoothness reads as either very advanced dermal maintenance or deliberate biological modification — she refuses clarification
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves slowly but never hesitantly, with the centered gravity of someone comfortable in stillness. Sits with her entire body at attention even when appearing relaxed. Her cat ears track independently of her gaze, giving the impression she is listening to multiple conversations, multiple rooms, multiple deaths simultaneously
physical_description.clothing_style: Practical layering favoring natural fabrics in muted tones — deep indigo, charcoal, warm browns. Loose-fitting wrapped garments suitable for long hours of sitting. Wears a distinctive wax-printed shawl in subtle geometric patterns (origin indeterminate). Tier 4 aesthetic: not poor, not wealthy, but deliberately outside corpo fashion cycles. Her indigo head wrap is her signature, replaced frequently but always in the same deep blue-black

image_prompt: A small, dark-skinned woman aged 71, round and soft-bodied, sitting motionless in dim light. She wears deep indigo wrapped cloth around her head and a wax-printed shawl in geometric patterns. Her skin is unusually smooth and luminous. Small mobile cat ears with dark tips protrude from her head, currently swiveled toward an unseen sound. Her expression is calm and indefinably ancient.
